entries.title: Lamentations 5:1
segments: ¶Keep in mind, O Lord, what has come to us: take note and see our shame.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:2
segments: Our heritage is given up to men of strange lands, our houses to those who are not our countrymen.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:3
segments: We are children without fathers, our mothers are like widows.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:4
segments: We give money for a drink of water, we get our wood for a price.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:5
segments: Our attackers are on our necks: overcome with weariness, we have no rest.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:6
segments: We have given our hands to the Egyptians and to the Assyrians so that we might have enough bread.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:7
segments: Our fathers were sinners and are dead; and the weight of their evil-doing is on us.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:8
segments: Servants are ruling over us, and there is no one to make us free from their hands.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:9
segments: We put our lives in danger to get our bread, because of the sword of the waste land.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:10
segments: Our skin is heated like an oven because of our burning heat from need of food.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:11
segments: They took by force the women in Zion, the virgins in the towns of Judah.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:12
segments: Their hands put princes to death by hanging: the faces of old men were not honoured.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:13
segments: The young men were crushing the grain, and the boys were falling under the wood.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:14
segments: The old men are no longer seated in the doorway, and the music of the young men has come to an end.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:15
segments: The joy of our hearts is ended; our dancing is changed into sorrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:16
segments: The crown has been taken from our head: sorrow is ours, for we are sinners.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:17
segments: ¶Because of this our hearts are feeble; for these things our eyes are dark;

entries.title: Lamentations 5:18
segments: Because of the mountain of Zion which is a waste; jackals go over it.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:19
segments: You, O Lord, are seated as King for ever; the seat of your power is eternal.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:20
segments: Why have we gone from your memory for ever? why have you been turned away from us for so long?

entries.title: Lamentations 5:21
segments: Make us come back to you, O Lord, and let us be turned; make our days new again as in the past.

entries.title: Lamentations 5:22
segments: But you have quite given us up; you are full of wrath against us.
